{6}{R}{R}: Monstrosity 3. (If this creature isn't monstrous, put three +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.)
When this creature becomes monstrous, creatures without flying your opponents control can't block this turn.

recipe_coverage: Pinned growth component with actual source casting, printed costs, both controllers, pending states, cleanup and replay. Mandatory monstrous companion effects have independent matching/nonmatching controller/type/subtype/indestructibility and survival/death controls. Explicit gaps: separate triggered-ability priority and response windows; resolve drains the complete stack; unexercised combat interactions and damage assignments; control changes; multiplayer. Functional combat controls distinguish pre-monstrous and active abilities and cleanup; Swarmborn resolves its printed player-damage sacrifice before restore, Colossus tests actual excess trample damage, and Stoneshock uses block-only legality probes (damage assignment is a gap) including a real newly cast flash blocker.
